description: This source file defines the InventoryController class, which exposes REST API endpoints for inventory management tasks such as fetching stock snapshots, reserving stock, and releasing reserved stock within an inventory service. It utilizes Spring Boot annotations for REST endpoints and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: InventoryController
classes.description: A REST controller managing inventory related API endpoints, including stock retrieval, reservation, and release functionalities.

methods.name: getStock
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch current stock information for a given store and SKU.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reserve stock synchronously during checkout or cart updates.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Handles POST requests to release previously reserved stock.
